        "text",
        "text_height",
        "length_factor"

        "ry*",
        "rotation",
        "start_angle",
        "end_angle"
      ],
      "draw_params": true

        "points*",
        "text*",
        "text_height"
      ],
      "draw_params": true

      "op": "add_line",

        "start*",
        "end*"

        "text_height"

        "count*",
        "total_angle",
        "rotate_items"

        "cols*",

        "col_spacing"

        "line2*",
        "d1*",
        "d2"

        "base",
        "to",
        "count"

        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "if_exists"

        "height",
        "if_exists"
      ]

        "entities*",
        "attributes",
        "if_exists"

        "target*",
        "confirm_large"

      "op": "delete_layer",

      "summary": "Delete a layer",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "delete_entities"
      ]

      "op": "explode",
      "category": "edit",

      "params": [
        "target*"

        "end"

        "line2*",

      "params": [

        "insert*",
        "scale",
        "rotation",
        "attributes"

      "params": [

        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "keep_original"
      ]

        "set*"

        "base",
        "to"

        "distance*",
        "side_point"

      "draw_params": true

        "angle*",
        "center*"

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "factor*",
        "center*"
      ]

      "op": "set_attributes",

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "values*"
      ]
    },

      "op": "set_properties",

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "layer",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "tag"
      ]

      "op": "stretch",

      "params": [
        "window*",
        "delta*"
      ]
    },

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "edges*",
        "pick*"
      ]
    }

- `apply_operations`：一次批量完成新建图层、删除对象、改图层和属性、删除空图层。
- `validate_drawing` 两次，`get_diff` 和 `read_drawing` 用于复核。

**遇到的错误和解决方法**
第一次校验有 7 条没过，都是我写的校验要求格式不对，不是图纸本身的问题：
- **尺寸 40**：没写标注类型，系统去找了线性标注，所以没找到。加上"直径标注"后通过。
- **对象数量**：6 条缺少对象类型这个必填字段。改为按"类型 + 图层"分别计数后全部通过。
